activity_summary: Master Thwaite reached fourteenthly and ended. Mistress Ansell called it sound doctrine. You said fourteen parts of it. She said it was the first sermon you had heard to the end. At the door Alse asked who decides where a permitted shade ends and an offence begins. Nobody answered the edge of it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said fourteen parts, and said the question was not his to decide.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Reached fourteenthly, closed the sermon, and sent them to dinner.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Called it sound doctrine, and moved the question off the porch.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked who decides where a permitted shade ends and an offence begins.

entities.name: the precept against blue starch

facets.activity: Heard fourteenthly, and Alse's question at the door
